Bulbs

The pale brown-skinned [ovoid](/wiki/Ovoid "Ovoid") [tunicate](/wiki/Tunica_(biology) "Tunica (biology)") [bulbs](/wiki/Bulb "Bulb") have a membranous tunic and a corky stem (base or basal) plate from which arise the [adventitious](/wiki/Adventitious#roots "Adventitious") [root hairs](/wiki/Root_hair "Root hair") in a ring around the edge, which grow up to 40 mm (1.6 in) in length. Above the stem plate is the storage organ consisting of bulb scales, surrounding the previous flower stalk and the terminal [bud](/wiki/Bud "Bud"). The scales are of two types, true storage organs and the bases of the foliage leaves. These have a thicker tip and a scar from where the leaf lamina became detached. The innermost leaf scale is semicircular, only partly enveloping the flower stalk (semisheathed). (see Hanks Fig 1.3). The bulb may contain a number of branched bulb units, each with two to three true scales and two to three leaf bases. Each bulb unit has a life of about four years.[[6]](#cite_note-FOOTNOTEHanks2002[httpsbooksgooglecombooksid4_kH_BffGDgCpgPA1_Hanks,_"The_biology_of_''Narcissus''"],_pp._1–29-7)[[7]](#cite_note-FOOTNOTEOkuboSochacki2012[httpsbooksgooglecombooksid5B-ucdbgA3wCpgPA104_104]-8)

Once the leaves die back in summer, the roots also wither. After some years, the roots shorten, pulling the bulbs deeper into the ground ([contractile roots](/wiki/Adventitious_roots "Adventitious roots")). The bulbs develop from the inside, pushing the older layers outwards which become brown and dry, forming an outer shell, the tunic or skin. Up to 60 layers have been counted in some wild species. While the plant appears dormant above the ground the flower stalk, which will start to grow in the following spring, develops within the bulb surrounded by two to three deciduous leaves and their sheaths. Qinghai's economy is amongst the smallest in China. Per capita GDP was RMB 60,724 (US$9,028) (nominal), the 24th in China.[[57]](#cite_note-data2022-62)

Its heavy industry includes iron and steel production, located near its capital city of Xining. Oil and natural gas from the [Qaidam Basin](/wiki/Qaidam_Basin "Qaidam Basin") have also been an important contributor to the economy.[[58]](#cite_note-thechinaperspective.com-63) Salt works operate at many of the province's numerous salt lakes.

Outside of the provincial capital, Xining, most of Qinghai remains underdeveloped. Qinghai ranks second lowest in China in terms of highway length, and will require a significant expansion of its infrastructure to capitalize on the economic potential of its rich natural resources.[[58]](#cite_note-thechinaperspective.com-63)

The two-term tradition, although not yet enshrined in the [Constitution](/wiki/United_States_Constitution "United States Constitution"),[[j]](#cite_note-239) had been established by [George Washington](/wiki/George_Washington "George Washington"). Roosevelt refused to give a definitive statement, and he even indicated to some ambitious Democrats, such as James Farley, that they could seek the Democratic nomination. Farley and Vice President John Garner were not pleased with Roosevelt when he ultimately ran.[[130]](#cite_note-FDR_Campaigns-134)[[230]](#cite_note-240) As Germany swept through [Western Europe](/wiki/Western_Europe "Western Europe") in mid-1940, Roosevelt decided that only he could see the nation safely through the Nazi threat.
